title: DesktopRefusal

code.description: Why: unavailable (no such desktop here), unsupported (this driver cannot), out_of_bounds (a coordinate outside the screenshot), stale_geometry (the display changed since the last screenshot), locked (the desktop is locked), cancelled, failed.
